privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.data: To work, the app stores your weight, habits, mood and, if you choose, height for BMI on this device.
privacy.storage: Data syncs with your account only so you can access it on other devices.
privacy.photos: Progress photos stay on this device and are never uploaded.

welcome.title: Welcome to EmagreSer
welcome.slogan: Take care of your weight. Reach your goals.

weight.title: What is your current weight?
weight.body: This is the starting point for tracking your progress. You can enter kg with one decimal place.
weight.label: Current weight (kg)

target.title: What is your goal?
target.body: Choose a target weight lower than your current one and the step for partial milestones.
target.label: Target weight (kg)

bmi.title: Do you want to track your BMI?
bmi.body: We only need your height to calculate BMI. This is optional: you can skip now and add it later in Settings.

reminder.title: When should we remind you?
reminder.body: Pick the time of your daily reminder. Notifications can be turned on later.
reminder.label: Reminder time

error.target: The target weight must be lower than your current weight.
error.height: Please enter a height between 100 and 250 cm.
error.save: We could not save. Please try again.
